description: This file implements the FailsafeFontResolver class which provides font resolving functionality, mapping font requests to specific SegoeWP fonts within a PDF processing library.

classes.name: FailsafeFontResolver
classes.description: A class that implements the IFontResolver interface, resolving font typefaces based on family name, bold, and italic attributes, specifically for SegoeWP fonts.

methods.name: ResolveTypeface
methods.description: Resolves and returns information about a typeface based on the font family name and style attributes (bold, italic).

methods.name: GetFont
methods.description: Retrieves the font byte array for a given faceName.
